author: J.E.& G.R.Gray, 1846
summary: 해안의 경작지나 초지에서 사는 새이다. 수컷은 흰 눈썹선과 검은 뺨이 눈에 띄고, 암컷은 멱과 배를 빼면 온몸이 갈색이다. 국외에서는 동남아시아, 인도, 방글라데시, 파키스탄 등지에 분포한다.

points.ko: 검은 세로줄 많은 회색 이마와 등
points.en: grey forehead and back heavily streaked black

sexes.male: 이마와 등은 회색에 검은 세로 줄무늬가 많고, 눈썹선은 희며 뺨은 검다. 아랫면은 희고 날개에 흰 줄이 있다.

art.subject: Grey Bush Chat (Saxicola ferreus), adult male in spring: crown, nape and mantle grey with heavy blackish streaks; long white supercilium; broad black mask from the lores through the cheeks and ear-coverts; throat white; breast and flanks pale grey, belly and undertail coverts whitish; wings blackish with a white patch on the inner wing-coverts that shows as a white stripe on the folded wing; rump grey; tail blackish. Bill black; dark eye; legs black.
art.scene: Korean coastal farmland with grassy field margins; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view perched: grey forehead, crown and mantle heavily streaked black, long white supercilium, black cheeks forming a mask, white throat, whitish underparts with a pale grey breast wash, white stripe on the folded blackish wing

adult female, side view perched: warm brown upperparts lightly streaked, buff supercilium, darker brown cheeks, whitish throat and belly, buffy-brown breast and flanks, rufous-brown rump and outer tail feathers
art.build: Slim chat, a little larger than a sparrow and longer-tailed than Amur Stonechat. Upright stance on bush tops, wires and tall stems, flicking its wings and tail. Bill short, thin, straight and black. Legs medium length, black. Wings short, the wingtips reaching only the base of the tail. Tail fairly long and square-ended, often flicked and spread.
avoid: Do not give the male a black head or orange breast; that is Amur Stonechat (Saxicola stejnegeri).
Do not leave out the long white supercilium or make the cheeks grey.
Do not paint a plain, unstreaked back on the male.
